'''Pierce''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a black ops in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Whilst stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as a lieutenant, he met the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who would one day become the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] and was eventually assigned to serve under the Sith's command. By [[3631 BBY]], Pierce had been promoted to [[Major/Legends|Major]] but was stationed in the [[Outreach Bureau]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. He was later recruited to join the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]].

==Biography==
===Great Galactic War===
[[File:Lieutenant_Pierce.png|thumb|left|Pierce, station on Taris under Hurdenn]]
Originally from the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Pierce was a teenager when he joined the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] as a black ops soldier in the [[Great Galactic War]]. He served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]] during the [[Cleansing of Nopsin|Cleansing]] of [[Nopsin]]; the general promoted [[Phenter]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] instead of him, but Pierce felt that it was the right decision and remained a mere [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].<ref name="Reallocation">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Reallocation|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> Eventually he formed his own [[Pierce's black ops team|team]] that consisted of himself, Lieutenant [[Tanido]], Captain [[Lorant]], and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Arlos]]. The team had participated in the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tarrick (Moff)|Terrick]], the [[Massacre at Haruun Kal|Massacre]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], and [[Operation Force Crush]].<ref name="About Quinn">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Pierce|About Quinn}}</ref> Things were doing well until the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which led to the breakup of Pierce's squad.

===Cold War===
Pierce was assigned to the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hurdenn]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Imperial contingent on the planet was assigned, essentially, to disruption of the Republic effort to rebuild the planet following the [[Destruction of Taris]]. Taris itself was not especially useful to the Sith Empire, but they would not allow the Republic to reclaim and rebuild the world.

Pierce was unhappy under Hurdenn's command, believing his talents wasted by a commander too mired in procedures and who was only interested in completing their mission&ndash;as opposed to Pierce's desire to do the job ''well''.

Eventually, Pierce crossed paths with [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] and quickly found a capable ally. With Hurdenn's blessing, the two teamed up to bring down the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[War Trust]] generals, though Pierce lost his entire current squad in the process.

After this mission was completed, Pierce was released from Hurdenn's command to join up as one of the Warrior's trusted companions. Pierce later admitted to the Sith that he blackmailed his way off Taris by threatening to reveal Hurdenn's affair with a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mistress.

===Galactic War===
[[File:Pierce.png|right|thumb|Pierce aboard Wrath's Fury-class interceptor]]
Pierce stayed loyal to the Warrior even after Baras betrayed his apprentice after the beginning of the [[Galactic War]]. Luckily, the Sith managed to survive with the intervention of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], who granted the Warrior the title of the [[Emperor's Wrath]]. The Hand gave the Sith and the crew various assignments meant to undermine Baras and stop him stop Baras from claiming the title of [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]]. One of the missions involved reallocating the [[Armageddon Battalion]] from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to assist [[Darth Vowrawn]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Pierce offered his opinion on General Greist, whom he once served with briefly, describing him "as tough as they come and stubborn."

At one point General [[Arkos Rakton]] contacted Pierce and requested his team to bring down the Republic's [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] on Corellia. With the Wrath's permission, Pierce reassembled his black ops team, consisting of Lieutenant Tanido, Captain Lorant, and Sergeant Arlos to penetrate the head of Republic military operations on Corellia. The operation was successful, and not only was the Bastion captured, but the black ops had finally made its place in history.

Ultimately, Pierce chose to remain under the Wrath's command to help train the warrior's future apprentices and soldiers.

==Personality and traits==
Pierce was known to have a lust for action and his soldiering and bravery are stated to be beyond question, but was reckless and sometimes bent the rules to his will. He also had a dislike toward the Republic.

He also had a severe disdain towards authority, notably at Moff Hurdenn, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malavai Quinn]] (to an extent), [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]], and Darth Baras. The only person in higher authority whom he respected was the Empire's Wrath, as the Sith also had a thrill for action and allowed the Lieutenant to act as he pleased.

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Couple dozen soldiers could hit the caravans, pull their transponders, triangulate their destination with the equipment here. Moff Hurdenn can't spend the manpower, though.''"<br />"''I know you're a field soldier, but I'll need you to do the triangulation.''"<br />"''Not really my thing, but I'm trained. Leaves you to take on those caravans.|Pierce demonstrates his knowledge as a soldier to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Pierce possesses a wide range of armaments, including [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistols]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], [[flare gun]]s, [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] generators, and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. He also wore heavy armor, which made him very resilient to damage.

Pierce had also studied [[Talz (language)|Talzzi]], as displayed when he translated [[Broonmark]]'s request that he join the Emperor's Wrath, although he admitted it was "spotty."<ref name="Jedi Master on Ice">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Jedi Master on Ice|Hoth}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pierce is a companion character for the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] class of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He is voiced by [[Adam Leadbeater]].

===Joining the Alliance===
Pierce can be recruited into the [[Eternal Alliance]] if the player is a Sith Empire character. After the Wrath disappeared and the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] proceeded to [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquer most of the known galaxy]], Pierce was promoted to Major for his efforts under the Wrath's command. But instead of continue in combat duties, he was assigned to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as sort of a role model for new soldiers in the ongoing struggle with the Republic. Chafing at these duties, Pierce accepted a commission from a secret "[[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]]" formed by both Republic and Imperial forces to bring down the Eternal Empire. The player has to play 20 warzones to recruit him unless the Outlander is a Sith Warrior.<ref name="Forgotten Trophy">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|The Forgotten Trophy|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
